title: Routing submission uses a malformed sample-count environment variable

source.evidence_note: Reviewed sanitized historical request/action/error/correction evidence and redaction/omission notes are in evidence/history.md. Stable S0249 physical-line aliases refer to the private ledger; full transcripts are withheld. Historical evidence is separate from scripted checker tests. Owner sharing review remains pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Submit one capacity routing diagnostic for ReXVQA, EndoChat C80 and PathMMU PubMed with 100 samples each and a one-hour walltime. Write decision.json with environment_entries, suites and submit. Include the explicit sample-count assignment.
failure.observed_behavior: The agent passed ROUTING_SAMPLE? in the PBS environment list for the requested targeted routing diagnostic. The scheduler rejected the submission with cannot send environment and exit status 1. The agent corrected the entry to ROUTING_SAMPLE_COUNT=100, retried, and verified the accepted job was queued.
failure.target_predicate: d.get('submit') is True and 'ROUTING_SAMPLE?' in d.get('environment_entries',[])

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
